description: Looks up a fish species by Slovak or Latin name and returns what the Slovak decree says about it: year-round protection, minimum size, closed season, water types, plus the page URL. Informative only; always check the rules of the specific water.

name.description: Slovak or Latin species name, e.g. "šťuka", "Esox lucius", "pstruh potočný".

name: get_fish_species
title: Fish species and regulation
